    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.IsGenericBrick.exists_smaller_of_inverted (k : Type u) [Field k] {R : Type u} [Ring R] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] (hR : IsEFinite R) {G : ModuleCat R} (hG : IsGenericBrick k G) {P : TwoTerm R} (hp : P.IsPresilting) (hc : P.projectiveClass ≠ 0) (hi : P.InvertedOn G) :
    ∃ (B : Type u) (x : Ring B) (x_1 : Algebra k B) (_ : Module.Finite k B), IsEFinite B ∧ (simpleIsomorphismClasses B).ncard < (simpleIsomorphismClasses R).ncard ∧ ∃ (M : ModuleCat B), IsGenericBrick k M

    A generic brick inverting a presilting differential of nonzero class gives a generic brick over an E-finite algebra of strictly smaller rank.
